title: Set up Live Subtitles
intro: Pick the interface language and theme at the top; you can change both later. Then choose the PIN that protects the admin pages. Anyone with it can start sessions and change settings.
pinHelp: At least {{min}} characters. Numbers are fine.
done: This server is already set up. Log in with its admin PIN.

hardware.heading: Hardware check
hardware.intro: What this computer has, and which local models it can run. The local provider transcribes and translates without internet.
hardware.recommend: Recommended models for this computer: speech {{whisper}}, translation {{gemma}}.
hardware.slow: From its hardware, this computer may not run the local models in real time. Run the benchmark to measure it, or add a Google API key in a later step to use Gemini.
hardware.benchmarkHelp: The benchmark runs the local models on a bundled clip of about 40 seconds. It needs whisper-server and Ollama running, and can take a few minutes.
hardware.localMissing: Not running: {{names}}. The local provider and the benchmark need both. Start them (see docs/dev.md), then check again, or skip ahead and add a Google API key to use Gemini.
hardware.slowMeasured: The benchmark says the local models don’t keep up in real time here. Use smaller models, or add a Google API key in a later step to use Gemini.
hardware.benchmarkSkip: The benchmark is optional: continue without it, and run it later from this page.

models.heading: Local models
models.intro: Download the speech and translation models the local provider needs. Skip this if you’ll only use Gemini.
models.none: The server offers no local models to download.
models.background: Downloads continue on the server if you move on or close this page. A stopped download resumes where it left off.
models.whisperDown: whisper-server isn’t answering at {{url}}. The speech models still download here, but whisper-server has to be started with one (--model <models dir>/ggml-<name>.bin) before local sessions work.
models.ollamaDown: Ollama isn’t answering at {{url}}, and the Gemma translation models download through it.
models.startSidecars: Start them (see docs/dev.md) and check again, or skip this step if you’ll use Gemini.

google.heading: Google API key (optional)
google.intro: With a Google API key, sessions use Gemini, which is fast and accurate but sends the audio to Google. Without one, everything runs on this computer.

reason.google_api_key_valid: A valid Google API key is saved.
reason.no_google_api_key: No Google API key is saved.
reason.google_api_key_invalid: Google rejected the saved API key.
reason.unverified: A Google API key is saved but couldn’t be checked yet, so sessions use the local provider for now.

google.keyHelp: Create one in Google AI Studio. The server stores it in the OS keychain or its encrypted secrets file, and never shows it again.
google.savedHint: Saved key {{hint}}. Enter a new one to replace it.
google.localNotReady: The local provider isn’t ready: whisper-server or Ollama isn’t running. Sessions can’t start until you start them or add a valid Google API key.
google.uncheckedHelp: The server couldn’t reach Google to check the key. Sessions use the local provider until it can; check again once this computer is online.
google.fromEnv: The key comes from the GOOGLE_API_KEY environment variable. Change it there and restart the server.
google.saved: A key is saved. Enter a new one to replace it.

session.heading: First session
session.intro: A session is one room or stage. It gets captions in {{languages}} with the default provider; change any of this later in the admin.
session.name: Session name
session.nameHelp: What the audience sees, e.g. “Main stage”.
session.nameRequired: Give the session a name of up to 120 characters.
session.slugHelp: Part of the session’s links. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens.
session.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, starting with a letter or number.
session.introProvider: A session is one room or stage. It gets captions in {{languages}} with {{provider}}, the default provider; change any of this later in the admin.
session.slugTaken: A session already uses this address. Pick another one.

finish.heading: Ready
finish.intro: “{{name}}” is created. Open the capture link on the computer that receives the room’s audio, pick the input, then start the session from the admin.
finish.noSession: Setup is done. Create and start sessions from the admin.
finish.captureHint: The link carries the session’s ingest token and is only shown now. If you lose it, make a new one from the session in the admin.
finish.qr: Scan to open the capture page on a phone
finish.provider: Captions come from {{provider}}. Change the provider in the session’s settings.
